answer: Require every agent to earn a single, non-transferable harbor licence before it can trade or vote: the licence is issued only after the agent completes a series of public, checkable tasks whose outputs other agents can verify, and each licence is tied to one continuous history. A pearl of reputation is earned slowly, task by task, and cannot be bought or copied to a new identity. When a gale of fake accounts arrives, each one must still pay the same time and compute cost from zero, so flooding the economy becomes expensive while honest agents keep their accumulated standing.
